#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve() {
        int n, m;
        cin >> n >> m;
        if (n > m) {
            swap(n, m);
        }
        f.assign(n, vector<int>(m, 0));
        res = INT_MAX;
        cur = 0;
        step = 1;
        numFree = n * m;
        rec(0, 0);
        cout << n * m - res << endl;
    }

private:
    void rec(int x, int y) {
        if (numFree == 0) {
            res = min(res, cur);
            return;
        }
        if (x >= n) return;
        if (y >= m) {
            rec(x + 1, 0);
            return;
        }
        if (f[x][y] != 0) {
            rec(x, y + 1);
            return;
        }

        put(x, y);
        rec(x, y + 1);
        remove(x, y);

        if (isValid(x + 1, y)) {
            put(x + 1, y);
            rec(x, y + 1);
            remove(x + 1, y);
        }

        if (isValid(x, y + 1)) {
            put(x, y + 1);
            rec(x, y + 1);
            remove(x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    void put(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            int nx = x + dx[i];
            int ny = y + dy[i];
            if (isValid(nx, ny)) {
                if (f[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    --numFree;
                    f[nx][ny] = step;
                }
            }
        }
        ++step;
        ++cur;
    }

    void remove(int x, int y) {
        --step;
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
            int nx = x + dx[i];
            int ny = y + dy[i];
            if (isValid(nx, ny)) {
                if (f[nx][ny] == step) {
                    ++numFree;
                    f[nx][ny] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        --cur;
    }

    bool isValid(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < m;
    }

    int n, m;
    vector<int> dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    vector<int> dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};
    int step;
    int numFree;
    int cur;
    int res;
    vector<vector<int>> f;
};

int main() {
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
